title: A new tenant sees another tenant's documents in answers
area: RAG and vector stores on AWS
scenario: Delta Outfitters, three days into its pilot, opens a P1 security ticket: answers about returns quote another company's policy and a citation points at /tenants/acme-foods/. Established tenants never saw this. The same release re-ingested the Knowledge Base with hierarchical chunking.
task: Find which Retrieve calls reached the KB without the tenant filter, and why only Delta
Rule the re-ingest in or out with evidence
Fix the retrieval path so no request can return another tenant's chunks
Write the exposure statement for the customer's CISO and the prevention plan
acceptance: Every Retrieve call is scoped to the caller; one call per question
Thin-tenant questions get a no-answer; foreign or untagged chunks are never context
Root cause, evidence and exposure statement in ANSWER.md

practices.label: Week 3 Wed - metadata filters and multi-tenancy
AI page - security (data the model sees)
